verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's first-party MCP docs say it connects to external MCP servers and makes their tools available to its agents. Servers can be added from the Control UI, the CLI, or config, which covers the core of this MCP-client story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that MCP server connections work in practice, and documented detail on supported transports, authentication and per-agent tool scoping.
